SFH.Settings.SequencesHint: Play the activation and shutdown animation when the projection is raised or lowered.
SFH.Device.OmniHint: Orange hologram projected from a forearm tool
SFH.Device.WristHint: Synthwave screen on a fold-out case
SFH.Settings.WorldDeviceHint: The device players get before they choose one of their own.
SFH.Settings.DeviceHint: The hardware you are wearing. Each player can choose their own.
SFH.Settings.DeckSizeHint: Size of the macro bar keys, in pixels. Lower this if the bar is wider than the device it sits on.
SFH.Settings.GridHint: The fine hex etching on the Mass Effect projection.
SFH.NoCharacter: No character to project. Assign one to yourself in the player list, or open the sheet you want and try again.
SFH.NoAdapter: The Sci-Fi HUD has no adapter for the {system} system yet, so there is nothing to project.
SFH.ActionFailed: The "{action}" action failed. See the console for details.
SFH.Keybind.HideHint: Clears the device and the projection off the screen without switching them off, so the projection comes back on the same tab. The macro bar stays.
SFH.Hide.Notice: The HUD is hidden. Press {key}, or the eye on the macro bar, to bring it back.
SFH.Hide.NoticeUnbound: The HUD is hidden. Press the eye on the macro bar to bring it back.
SFH.Settings.ControlIconsHint: Gives the scene controls on the left of the screen sci-fi icons — an astronaut for tokens, a radar for measuring, a datapad for notes. Turn it off to keep Foundry's own.
SFH.Settings.ProjScale: Wrist computer and EVA projection size
SFH.Settings.ProjScaleHint: How much of the free space the Wrist Computer and EVA projections take, as a percentage. Lower it to keep more of the map in view. The Mass Effect omni-tool is not affected: its projection always matches the width of its arm, which follows Macro key size.
